run_evolution_iteration: run a single OpenEvolve iteration that samples a parent program and generates an evolved child
create_result_dataclass: create a Result dataclass to hold child program, metrics, prompt, and LLM response from an iteration
sample_parent_and_inspirations: sample a parent program and top inspiration programs from the shared database for evolution
generate_code_with_llm_ensemble: generate a code modification by sending the built prompt to the LLM ensemble
apply_diff_or_full_rewrite: apply diff blocks or a full code rewrite to produce the child program from the parent
